method: Author recomputation from declared synthetic inputs with standard-library mathematics; not independent project verification.

checks.boundary: Gravity similarity only; Reynolds/Weber and air effects need separate review.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.

checks.boundary: Unit-width discharge scales as length^1.5, not total flow length^2.5.

checks.boundary: Closed collection balance and effective width/time.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance.

checks.boundary: Spectral significant height, not maximum individual height.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1.

checks.boundary: Fixed crest and incident-height assumption; depth changes also need recalibration.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40.

checks.boundary: Separated amplitudes and matched propagation conditions for energy square.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16.

checks.boundary: Ideal Nyquist is not usable bandwidth or proof of impact resolution.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks.

checks.boundary: Local flow regime, not access safety.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision.

checks.boundary: Sample deviation with n-1; independent realizations only.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented.

checks.boundary: Uniform instantaneous area-average, not a local pressure spike.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak.

checks.boundary: Individual displaced volume, not loose bulk stockpile volume.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN.

checks.boundary: Indicator has no universal acceptance threshold.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned.

checks.boundary: Porosity differs from void ratio; connectivity separate.

checks.boundary: Horizontal run differs from slope length.

checks.boundary: Grading ratio alone does not satisfy every filter criterion.

checks.boundary: Cube-root volume nominal diameter, not longest axis.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension.

checks.boundary: Steady drag only; inertia, turbulent peaks and changing exposure excluded.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設ρ=1025kg/m³、Cd=1、投影A=2m²、定常v=2m/s，F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. F=ρCdAv²/2=4100N=4.1kN.

checks.boundary: Uniform layer strain only; differential/other-layer settlement excluded.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a3m layer with uniform vertical strain0.02. Settlement s=εH=0.060m excludes other layers and differential movement.

checks.boundary: Symmetric static slings with angle from vertical; no field lifting setting.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設靜態重量100kN由兩索對稱承擔，各與垂直夾30°，T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN；不含動載。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume static100kN shared symmetrically by two slings each30° from vertical. T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN, excluding dynamic loading.

checks.boundary: Damage area normalized by Dn² is not a percentage.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage.

checks.boundary: Concrete volume is not buoyant envelope volume.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy.

checks.boundary: Sealed rectangular waterplane and calm-water draft/freeboard.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設總質量2460000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，吃水T=m/(ρA)=6m；側高10m時靜態乾舷4m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass2460000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². Draft T=m/(ρA)=6m; a10m side gives static freeboard4m.

checks.boundary: Small-angle GM, not complete righting-arm stability.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m.

checks.boundary: Part-filled connected free surface; tank liquid matches surrounding density.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation.

checks.boundary: Fixed waterplane and sealed body; mean draft only.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition.

checks.boundary: Assumed linear static base pressure; time and intermediate peaks excluded.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米堤長、底寬20m，底壓由80線性降至20kPa，U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m；未計時變壓力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit breakwater length,20m base width and linear pressure from80 to20kPa. U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m, excluding time variation.

checks.boundary: Effective normal load and assumed friction; not code safety factor.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米W=4000kN、U=1000kN、μ=0.6、H=1500kN，R=μ(W−U)=1800kN，R/H=1.20；非規範安全係數。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre W=4000kN, U=1000kN, μ=0.6 and H=1500kN. R=1800kN and R/H=1.20, not a code safety factor.

checks.boundary: Rectangular linear full-contact boundary; ground tension not allowed.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=2000kN、M=4000kN·m、B=12m，e=M/N=2m=B/6；qmax=333.3kPa、qmin=0，為全接觸邊界。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre N=2000kN, M=4000kN·m and B=12m. e=2m=B/6; qmax=333.3kPa and qmin=0 at the full-contact boundary.

checks.boundary: Small rigid-body rotation only.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩端相距20m、沉陷差20mm，θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573°；只作剛體小角示意。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume endpoints20m apart with20mm differential settlement. θ≈0.020/20=0.001rad=0.0573° is a small rigid-body illustration.

checks.boundary: Two static pressure triangles on same base; no tsunami/suction/scour claim.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同底面起算兩側靜水深8與6m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，每米淨力F=γ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN；非海嘯力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume still depths8m and6m from one base and seawater γ=10.05525kN/m³. Net force per metre isγ(8²−6²)/2=140.7735kN, not tsunami force.

checks.boundary: Material volume and submerged weight; no proprietary product specification.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾質量3000kg、材料密度2400kg/m³，實體V=M/ρ=1.25m³；海水1025kg/m³時有效重為16.86kN，非產品規格。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. checks.boundary: Absorbed water removed from effective water, no surface water assumed.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設膠材340kg、加入水170kg，其中8kg被乾骨材吸收且無表面水，有效水膠比(170−8)/340=0.4765；非配方建議。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. checks.boundary: Uniform free thermal movement, no restraint or gradient stress.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、均勻溫差25K、長L=2m，自由變形ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm；不含約束。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeα=10⁻⁵/K, uniform change25K and length2m. Free movement ΔL=αΔTL=0.0005m=0.50mm, excluding restraint.

checks.boundary: Fully restrained linear elastic cooling; creep and cracking excluded.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設E=25GPa、α=10⁻⁵/K、完全約束冷卻25K，σ=EαΔT=6.25MPa拉應力；實際開裂與徐變需另算。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume E=25GPa,α=10⁻⁵/K and fully restrained cooling25K. Elastic tensionσ=EαΔT=6.25MPa; cracking and creep require separate treatment.

checks.boundary: Cube nominal compressive strength, not characteristic/design strength.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength.

checks.boundary: Symmetric static slings45degrees from vertical; no dynamic/attachment approval.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設質量3000kg、兩索各與垂直45°且靜態對稱，T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN；未含動載或偏心。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass3000kg and two symmetric static slings45° from vertical. T=3000×9.81/(2cos45°)=20.81kN, excluding dynamics and eccentricity.

checks.boundary: Placement density is not porosity or complete interlocking evidence.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity.

checks.boundary: Position-vector magnitude, not orientation error.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error.

checks.boundary: Equal material density with geometric length ratio20; contact/roughness separate.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype mass3000kg, length ratio20 and equal material density. Model mass=3000/20³=0.375kg, with submerged relative density checked separately.

checks.boundary: Specified abrasion test, not annual service-life rate.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設試樣乾質量1.000kg，指定磨耗試驗後0.950kg，損失(1−0.95)/1=5%；不能直接推成每年損失5%。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry sample1.000kg and0.950kg after a specified abrasion test. Loss is5%, which cannot be interpreted as5% annual service loss.

checks.boundary: Rectangular geometry, not an equilibrium-profile design.
checks.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.

checks.boundary: Dry grain mass excludes pore water.

checks.boundary: Median ratio does not prove full grading compatibility.

checks.boundary: Assumed parallel translation across fixed active-profile height.
